intro: Vietnamese culture mixes ancient local traditions with Chinese and French influences, from water puppets to bánh mì.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: Tết, the Lunar New Year, is the biggest festival. Water puppetry, where puppets dance across a pool, comes from the rice paddies of the north. The áo dài is the elegant national dress.

chapters.title: Food
text: Phở noodle soup, bánh mì sandwiches (a French baguette with Vietnamese fillings), fresh spring rolls and fish sauce define the cuisine. Vietnamese coffee is strong and sweet, sometimes made with egg.
